item.name: Find ZIP/postal codes within a radius

request.name: Find ZIP/postal codes within a radius

description.content: Returns every ZIP/postal code within the given radius of a center point, specified either by code plus country or by latitude/longitude coordinates.

query.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.
Postal/ZIP code to use as the center point for the search. Requires country to be set. Alternative to lat/long.
Latitude coordinate for the center point. Alternative to code/country.
Longitude coordinate for the center point. Alternative to code/country.
Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format. Required only when using the code parameter.
(Required) Search radius for the query. The maximum allowed values are: 100 km, 100 mi, 109361 yd, 100000 m, 328084 ft, 3937007.75 in.
Unit for the radius and returned distance values. Supported distance units are m, km, mi, ft, yd, in.
Page number to retrieve. Each page returns up to 500 results.
